newsitem.title: USA: Siemens unit to supply Western Wireless.
newsitem.headline: Siemens unit to supply Western Wireless.

text.p: A unit of Siemens Business Communication Systems Inc said Tuesday it had won a three-year contract worth more than $35 million to supply digital portable phones to Western Wireless Corp.
Siemens Wireless Terminals said Western would offer its g1050 handsets in the areas where it operates like Honolulu, Salt Lake City and Portland, Oregon, as of next June.
Based in Issaquah, Wash., Western Wireless provides wireless communications services (better known as personal communications services or PCS) in the western United States.
It also provides cellular service in 15 western states.
Siemens Business Communication Systems belongs to Siemens AG in Germany.
PCS is the next generation of wireless communications in the transmission of voice and data.
